newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen Water to issue 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Water to issue 1996 dividend.

text.p: Shenzhen Health Mineral Water Co Ltd said on Monday it would make a pre-tax cash payment of 0.118 yuan per share as a dividend for 1996.

Holders of the company's hard currency B shares would receive the dividend in Hong Kong dollars at an exchange rate of 1.0 yuan to HK$1.0708, the company said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The registration deadline for B shares and domestic currency A shares was set for July 28, and the shares would go ex-dividend on July 29, the statement said.
The dividend would be deposited into the accounts of B share holders on August 1, it said.
The company booked net profits of 33.97 million yuan for 1996 against 22.57 million yuan in 1995 under international accounting standards.

The firm had been in discussions with French food group Danone about setting up a mineral water venture in Shenzhen, an official for the Chinese company recently told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
But the official declined to disclose the amount of investment involved or a timetable for the project.
